name: iMitzvah
summary: A personal companion for the 613 mitzvot, built on the original Torah text instead of secondhand summaries.
challenge: Most people meet the 613 mitzvot through layers of later summaries, and the full list feels impossibly long. The bet behind iMitzvah: show the literal source text, filter it to what actually applies to you, and the list becomes short, clear and doable.
product: A source-first app: every mitzvah in Hebrew and English straight from the Torah text, a personal checklist filtered by age, gender and life stage, a Tzadik score that tracks progress, AI voice playback, and a visual map linking verses across the Tanach. Planned stack: React Native and Node.js, synced with Sefaria’s open text library.
status: The product requirements are written and the first app flow is designed. Next: a mobile-first redesign of that flow and a working POC.
